text: {"lessons":["Holding every position unchanged for many periods is still a decision; I should review whether each holding and the overall portfolio fit my plan rather than defaulting to inaction.","My account value moved both up and down while I made no trades, reinforcing that I cannot control short-term outcomes through frequent activity or predict them from past price changes.","I should judge positions by their future risk and potential contribution to the portfolio, not by whether they are above or below my average cost or by a desire to avoid admitting a mistake."]}
